welcome_text: Hello! My name is Ingrid Bianchi
who_i_am: From business strategist to full-stack with a UX soul

I used to live between sales strategies and multidisciplinary teams, always chasing the most efficient way to get things done. But then I thought: ‘What if I bring my passion for connecting to the tech world?’ 🚀
Now I blend web development with user-centered design, understanding what people want and need to create solutions that truly make an impact.

My superpower: a 360° vision that combines empathy and strategy. I study the market and competitors to know if a product will soar before writing a single line of code. With experience in e-commerce, CRM, and agile methodologies, I translate business needs into solid tech.
I’m passionate about turning ideas into interactive systems that captivate. Every bug fixed, every seamless experience, is a step toward something big.
Ready to build something that makes a difference? 🌟
